eva: FYI ran a soft onboarding of v5-lite-int4 on the long-doc route at 2% for a 2h smoke. latency improved (p95 -100ms) and cost -19%, but long-doc MRR shows -1.9% (p=0.03). anchor concordance for legal prompts down -1.8%. thinking we need a bayesian-capacitor gate before further ramps. cc @chris @mohan

chris: can you paste the brief numbers and sample sizes? is the anchor drop concentrated or widespread?

eva: snapshot: tokens ~240k for slice, long-doc sessions ~2.1k, p50 -35ms, p95 -100ms, cost/tokens -19%, long-doc MRR -1.9% (CI uses bootstrap), anchor-set legal -1.8% (p=0.03), hallucination +0.2pp.

mohan: the tradeoff looks real. propose rule: require min_tokens=200k AND posterior_prob(MRR_drop>1.5%)>0.9 AND consecutive_windows=2 for hard rollback. otherwise hold + shadow. also add top-20 KL check; if KL>0.12 and anchor_drop>=1% then escalate.

eva: makes sense. also cap per-slice ramp to max 4% if slice traffic <1%. avoid noisy overreaction. add a cooldown of 75 minutes post-rollback and jitter +/-12% on promotions.

chris: operationally, prefer a three-state promoter: promote -> hold (shadow) -> rollback. Transition to rollback only when (a) bayes posterior >0.9 AND tokens>=min_tokens OR (b) hallucination_pp >=0.5. If anchor drop but global MRR stable (<0.4%) then automatically move to hold and run 48h shadow at same tier.

mohan: agreed. suggest smoothing MRR with Bayesian credible interval over two windows (2h each) to reduce spike sensitivity. Use an empirical Bayes prior based on historical slice variance.

eva: draft gate yaml (inline):

```yaml
bayesian_capacitor_gate:
  min_tokens: 200000
  posterior_threshold: 0.9
  mrr_drop_threshold_pct: 1.5
  consecutive_windows: 2
  hallucination_rollback_pp: 0.5
  kl_threshold_top20: 0.12
  max_slice_ramp_pct: 4
  cooldown_minutes: 75
  promotion_jitter_pct: 12
  post_detection_action: hold_and_shadow_48h
```

sre-bot: note: promoter changes require a small migration bump. will apply feature-flag and run canary. also will auto-create alert if posterior>0.8 and tokens>=150k.

chris: also add rule: if slice MRR drop >1% but global MRR stable within 0.4%, do not auto-rollback; convert to slice-routing -> route that slice to int8 fallback variant for 24h while shadow runs. call it "slice-fallback-routing".

mohan: add tie-breaker: if KL>0.18 AND anchor_drop>1.2% -> urgent rollback even if global stable (behavioral-critical content).

eva: okay action items: (1) push bayesian_capacitor_gate to promoter behind FF, (2) start 48h shadow for long-doc legal anchor at 2% and capture 500k tokens, (3) enable KL profiling every 6h, (4) add dashboard panels: posterior MRR, top-20 KL, slice token counts, and slice-routing status. i'll post the 12h shadow snapshot here.
